interface.name: agl_shell
interface.description:
Privileged clients that implement a shell for Automotive Grade Linux use this interface to set up background and panel surfaces, and to activate running applications.
Only one client at a time may bind this global; the compositor rejects additional bindings.

entry.name: background_exists
entry.summary: a background surface already exists on that output

entry.name: panel_exists
entry.summary: a panel surface already exists on that output/edge

request.name: ready

description.summary: signal the compositor that the shell is ready

request.description: Signal the compositor that the shell client is fully initialised and ready to manage surfaces. The compositor may display a splash screen or remain in a default state until this request is received.

request.name: set_background

description.summary: set a surface as the desktop background

request.description: Promote a wl_surface to a background surface on the given output. The surface is scaled to cover the entire output. Sending this request a second time for the same output produces a background_exists protocol error.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface to promote to background

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the output on which to place the background

request.name: set_panel

description.summary: set a surface as a panel along an output edge

request.description: Promote a wl_surface to a panel surface anchored at the given edge of the given output. Panel surfaces reduce the usable area that the compositor allocates for regular application windows. Sending this request a second time for the same output/edge produces a panel_exists protocol error.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface to promote to panel

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the output on which to place the panel

arg.name: edge
arg.summary: which edge the panel is anchored to

request.name: activate_app

description.summary: activate a running application by app-id

request.description: Bring an already-running application to the foreground on the given output. The compositor finds the xdg_toplevel with a matching app_id and raises it. If no matching app_id is found the request is silently ignored.

arg.name: app_id
arg.summary: XDG application identifier of the app to activate

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the output on which to activate the application

event.name: app_state
event.description: The compositor sends this event when the visible state of a managed application changes (e.g. when it is activated or deactivated).
